**Chosen one-shot formulation:**

- **Ethanol:** **50.0 v/v%**
- **SDS:** **0.75 w/v%**

**Rationale:** The best valid result so far was near this SDS level: `34.555% ethanol / 0.752% SDS → 68.108°`. Since all measured contact angles are still above 65°, and ethanol is expected to further lower the contact angle, pushing ethanol to the corrected upper bound while keeping SDS near the best-performing concentration is the most plausible one-shot move toward 65°.
